output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk[["set"]](echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(deSolve)
```

## 1. SEACRD Model Setup & Comparison Scenarios
Here we add the Exposed (`E`) compartment (`v = 1/4`, 4-day latent period) and a pre-symptomatic infectiousness weight `delta` on `E`. We compare three scenarios:
1. **Baseline `SEACRD`** (`v = 1/4`, `delta = 0`)
2. **Instantaneous progression** (`v = 1e10`, `delta = 0` — equivalent to `SACRD`)
3. **Pre-symptomatic transmission** (`v = 1/4`, `delta = 0.5`)

```{r seacrd-scenarios}
SEACRD <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    P <- (S + E + A + C + R)
    
    # Force of infection includes Asymptomatic (rho*A), Clinical (C), and Exposed (delta*E)
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * (rho * A + C + delta * E) / P
    
    dS <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S   
    dE <- lam * S - v * E - mu * E
    dA <- (1 - gamma) * v * E - taua * A - mu * A
    dC <- gamma * v * E - tauc * C - mu * C 
    dR <- (1 - phi) * tauc * C + taua * A - mu * R
    dD <- phi * tauc * C
    
    list(c(dS, dE, dA, dC, dR, dD))
  }) 
}

# Initial conditions (P = 999, 1 initial clinical case)
initP <- 999 
initE <- 0
initA <- 0
initC <- 1
initR <- 0 
initD <- 0
initS <- initP - initE - initA - initC - initR
istate <- c(S = initS, E = initE, A = initA, C = initC, R = initR, D = initD)

parameters <- c(
  mu = (1 / (50 * 52 * 7)),    
  beta = 0.25, 
  v = 1 / 4,      # Progression rate from E -> A/C (4-day latent period)
  gamma = 0.2,    # 20% develop clinical symptoms
  taua = 1 / 10,  # 10-day asymptomatic duration
  tauc = 1 / 10,  # 10-day clinical duration
  phi = 0.05,     # 5% clinical CFR
  rho = 1,        # Relative infectiousness of A
  delta = 0.0     # Relative infectiousness of E (pre-symptomatic transmission)
)

time_start <- 0
time_stop <- 600
deltat <- 0.1
tps <- seq(time_start, time_stop, by = deltat)

# Scenario 1: Baseline SEACRD (4-day latent period, non-infectious E)
out <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SEACRD, parms = parameters) 
Result <- as.data.frame(out)

# Scenario 2: Huge progression rate (v = 1e10) -> collapses SEACRD into SACRD
parameters['v'] <- 1e10
out2 <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SEACRD, parms = parameters) 
Result2 <- as.data.frame(out2)

# Scenario 3: Pre-symptomatic infectiousness (v = 1/4, delta = 0.5)
parameters['v'] <- 1 / 4
parameters['delta'] <- 0.5
out3 <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SEACRD, parms = parameters) 
Result3 <- as.data.frame(out3)

# Plot 1: Phase plane S vs (A + C)
plot(Result[["S"]], Result[["C"]] + Result[["A"]], type = "l", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, 300), xlim = c(0, 1000), xlab = "Susceptible (S)", ylab = "Active Infected (A + C)",
     main = "Phase Plane: Effect of Latent Delay (v) & Pre-Symptomatic Spread (delta)")
lines(Result2[["S"]], Result2[["C"]] + Result2[["A"]], col = "lightcoral", lwd = 3)
lines(Result3[["S"]], Result3[["C"]] + Result3[["A"]], col = "plum", lwd = 3)
legend("topright", legend = c("SEACRD (v=1/4, delta=0)", "SACRD limit (v=1e10, delta=0)", "Pre-symptomatic (v=1/4, delta=0.5)"),
       col = c("black", "lightcoral", "plum"), lwd = c(2, 3, 3))

# Plot 2: Phase plane R vs (A + C)
plot(Result[["R"]], Result[["C"]] + Result[["A"]], type = "l", lwd = 2,
     ylim = c(0, 300), xlim = c(0, 1000), xlab = "Recovered (R)", ylab = "Active Infected (A + C)")
lines(Result2[["R"]], Result2[["C"]] + Result2[["A"]], col = "lightcoral", lwd = 3)
lines(Result3[["R"]], Result3[["C"]] + Result3[["A"]], col = "plum", lwd = 3)

# Plot 3: Active Infections (A + C) over time steps
plot(Result[["C"]] + Result[["A"]], type = "l", lwd = 2, ylim = c(0, 300),
     xlab = "Time Step (0.1 days)", ylab = "Active Infected (A + C)", main = "Epidemic Curves Over Time")
lines(Result2[["C"]] + Result2[["A"]], col = "lightcoral", lwd = 3)
lines(Result3[["C"]] + Result3[["A"]], col = "plum", lwd = 3)

# Compare cumulative person-days of infection across all 3 scenarios
sum(Result[["C"]] + Result[["A"]])
sum(Result2[["C"]] + Result2[["A"]])
sum(Result3[["C"]] + Result3[["A"]])
```

## 2. Two-Way Parameter Sweep: Progression Rate (`v`) vs. Pre-Symptomatic Spread (`delta`)
Here we vary `v` (0.1 to 1.0) and `delta` (0.2 to 1.0) and record the final Recovered count (`out[, 6]`, i.e., `R` at Day 600) to see how pre-symptomatic transmission drives total outbreak size.

```{r contour-v-delta}
v_vector <- seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)
delta_vector <- seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.1)
result <- matrix(0, nrow = length(v_vector), ncol = length(delta_vector))

for (i in 1:length(v_vector)) {
  for (j in 1:length(delta_vector)) {
    parameters["v"] <- v_vector[i]
    parameters["delta"] <- delta_vector[j]
    
    out <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SEACRD, parms = parameters) 
    
    # Column 6 is R (Recovered) at t = 600 days
    result[i, j] <- tail(out[, 6], 1)
  }
}

contour(result, xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n", xlab = "Progression Rate (v)", ylab = "Pre-symptomatic Infectiousness (delta)", 
        nlevels = 10, labcex = 1.2, col = hcl.colors(12, "Temps"), lwd = 2,
        main = "Final Recovered Population (R) by v and delta")
axis(1, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(v_vector)), labels = v_vector)
axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(delta_vector)), labels = delta_vector)
```
